description: Official tier list for all units and buildings in Mini War Roblox. Rankings based on power, cost efficiency, and strategic value.

tiers.description: Top-tier. Must-have for any competitive strategy.
Excellent. Strong choice for most strategies.
Average. Early game or niche use.

units.name: Tank
units.specialAbility: High damage dealer, best for boss raids
units.description: The ultimate heavy hitter. Tanks dominate late-game battles and boss raids with unmatched damage output.

units.name: Helicopter
units.description: Air superiority unit. Unlocks the most profitable farming activity (Air Strike Operation) and provides unmatched mobility.

units.name: Combat Mech
units.description: The workhorse of mid-game. Combat Mechs provide the best cost-to-power ratio for sustained farming operations.

units.name: Worker Mech
units.description: Economic powerhouse. Worker Mechs boost resource gathering, making them essential for early-to-mid game economy.

units.name: Infantry
units.specialAbility: Fast to produce, cheap to replace
units.description: Cannon fodder with strategic value. Infantry are cheap and fast to produce, perfect for swarm tactics and defense waves.

buildings.name: Military Base
buildings.description: End-game military infrastructure. Unlocks the most profitable content including boss raids.

buildings.name: Airport
buildings.description: Air power hub. Required for helicopter deployment and air strike missions.

buildings.name: Mech Bay
buildings.description: Combat Mech production facility. Essential mid-game building.

buildings.name: Barracks
buildings.description: Infantry training facility. Enables military mission access.

buildings.name: Factory
buildings.description: Industrial multiplier. Boosts overall income output significantly.

buildings.name: Farm
buildings.description: Starter building. Provides baseline passive income. Upgrade priority is low after early game.
